title: Utility Order for Pointe Coupee Electric Membership Corporation, ex parte. — Order No. U-37894 accepts the Joint Report for the 2025 Test Year Rate Stabilization Plan filing submitted on July 23, 2026, which states that no rate change is necessary and in accordance with the terms of Pointe Coupee Electric Membership Corporation Formula Rate Plan. This matter was considered at the August 12, 2026 Business and Executive Session.
